intent: Reuse existing Reality, Judgment/revision, replay and orchestration capabilities to promote the already-grounded HBM3E packet without collapsing distinct status states. Persist only issuer-reported current production/sampling states as Reality, preserve forward-looking platform shipment/customer supply/mass-production timing as contemporaneous Judgments, and express Samsung's later Q2 12H mass-production plan as a narrowing revision of its earlier 1H plan. No claim may infer named-customer qualification unless a source explicitly supports it.
rationale: Issue #152 proved four content-verified HBM3E fragments can be grounded 4/4/0/0. Their status components fit existing generic owners: CAP-0003 for narrow observed Reality, CAP-0004 for contemporaneous future timing and the Samsung plan revision, CAP-0005 for no-lookahead replay, and CAP-0007 for phase composition. The exercise is specifically meant to prove that product development/sampling/production/supply/platform timing can remain distinct without a semiconductor-specific status model.
